title: 车队 II
summary: 车辆按位置递增向右行驶且速度恒定，碰撞后车队以较慢速度前进；求每辆车首次撞到下一车辆的时间，不会碰撞返回负一。
insight: 从右向左维护可能被追上的车辆栈。若当前车不比栈顶快，永远追不上它；若理论碰撞时间晚于栈顶自身碰撞时间，则届时栈顶状态已改变，也应跳过它。
pitfalls: 候选车无碰撞时理论追上时间总有效

solutions.title: 从右向左碰撞单调栈
solutions.idea: 删除不可能成为当前车首次碰撞对象的右侧车辆。
steps: answer 全 -1，stack 存右侧车辆下标
i 从右向左：栈顶速度>=当前速度则弹出
计算 time；若 answer[top]<0 或 time<=answer[top] 则有效，否则弹出继续；有效时记录并压入 i

code.java: class Solution { public double[] getCollisionTimes(int[][] cars){int n=cars.length;double[] answer=new double[n];Arrays.fill(answer,-1);Deque<Integer> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){while(!stack.isEmpty()){int next=stack.peekLast();if(cars[i][1]<=cars[next][1]){stack.pollLast();continue;}double time=(double)(cars[next][0]-cars[i][0])/(cars[i][1]-cars[next][1]);if(answer[next]<0||time<=answer[next]){answer[i]=time;break;}stack.pollLast();}stack.offerLast(i);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun getCollisionTimes(cars:Array<IntArray>):DoubleArray{val answer=DoubleArray(cars.size){-1.0};val stack=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();for(i in cars.lastIndex downTo 0){while(stack.isNotEmpty()){val next=stack.last;if(cars[i][1]<=cars[next][1]){stack.removeLast();continue};val time=(cars[next][0]-cars[i][0]).toDouble()/(cars[i][1]-cars[next][1]);if(answer[next]<0||time<=answer[next]){answer[i]=time;break};stack.removeLast()};stack.addLast(i)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<double> getCollisionTimes(vector<vector<int>>& cars){int n=cars.size();vector<double> answer(n,-1);vector<int> stack;for(int i=n-1;i>=0;--i){while(!stack.empty()){int next=stack.back();if(cars[i][1]<=cars[next][1]){stack.pop_back();continue;}double time=(double)(cars[next][0]-cars[i][0])/(cars[i][1]-cars[next][1]);if(answer[next]<0||time<=answer[next]){answer[i]=time;break;}stack.pop_back();}stack.push_back(i);}return answer;} };
